what_it_does: Pay-as-you-go SEO data APIs: SERPs, keywords, backlinks, on-page, domain analytics.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic auth with API login/password from the API Access dashboard; docs say Basic is the only way to access the API.
access_notes: Free account signup gives API credentials plus $1 free credit, no credit card; then pay-as-you-go. Sandbox listed in docs appendix.
api_notes: v3 REST APIs across SERP, Keywords Data, Backlinks, OnPage, DataForSEO Labs, Domain Analytics, Content Analysis, etc.

what_it_does: SEO platform: rank tracking, backlinks, keyword research, audits, AI search visibility.
auth_notes: Single API key (created in API dashboard) authenticates both Data API and Project API via api.seranking.com; exact REST header format not confirmed. Official MCP accepts OAuth browser sign-in or X-Api-Key header.
access_notes: 14-day trial includes 100,000 API credits. Ongoing API included in Core/Growth/Enterprise plans (some legacy plans need API add-on).
api_notes: Data API (backlinks, domains, keywords, AI Search, audits) and Project API (projects, rankings, audits, competitors); credit-based.

what_it_does: SEO toolset: backlinks, keywords, site audit, rank tracking, competitive analysis.
auth_notes: API v3 key sent as Authorization: Bearer; only workspace owners/admins can create keys. Hosted MCP supports OAuth consent (creates MCP-scoped key) or manual MCP key.
access_notes: API v3 available on Lite and higher paid plans (not Enterprise-only; Enterprise needed only for custom endpoints). Other plans get a limited set of free test queries; some endpoints cost 0 units.
api_notes: 15 endpoint groups incl. Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, Site Audit, Rank Tracker, SERP Overview, Batch Analysis, Brand Radar, GSC Insights; API-unit metered.
human_needed: buy Lite+ subscription for full API testing

what_it_does: AI-powered web scraping: HTML/markdown/JSON extraction, screenshots, search, workflows.
auth_notes: API token in x-api-token header (marketplace endpoints use Authorization: Bearer). Hosted MCP uses OAuth 2.1 or Bearer API key fallback.
access_notes: Free plan with monthly tokens, no credit card (docs inconsistent: 100 vs 1,000 tokens); API use on free plan implied but not stated explicitly.
api_notes: Base https://api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1; web search, scrape HTML/markdown/JSON, screenshot, workflows, bulk results, analytics.

what_it_does: Cloud platform for running web scrapers and automation Actors, plus storage.
auth_notes: Personal API token in Authorization header (recommended) or token query param. Official MCP supports OAuth sign-in or Bearer token.
access_notes: Free plan with $5/month platform usage, no credit card required.
api_notes: API v2 covers Actors, runs, tasks, datasets, key-value stores, request queues, schedules, webhooks, store.

what_it_does: Web scraping/crawling API that turns sites into LLM-ready markdown or JSON.
access_notes: Free plan: 1,000 credits/month, no credit card, 2 concurrent requests.
api_notes: v2 endpoints: Search, Scrape, Interact, Parse, Monitor, Crawl, Map, Agent.

what_it_does: Proxy network and web data platform: unlocker, SERP, scraper and browser APIs.
auth_notes: API key as Authorization: Bearer; default key auto-created on signup, admins create more. Proxy (native) access uses zone username/password.
access_notes: Free tier: 5,000 credits/month across Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper, Scraper Studio, Browser API; no credit card. Proxy products not included.
api_notes: Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper API (datasets), Browser API, Scraper Studio, proxy and account management APIs.

what_it_does: Open-source CLI that finds accounts by username across 400+ social sites.
auth_notes: No credentials; runs locally (pipx/pip/uv, Docker sherlock/sherlock, dnf).
access_notes: MIT-licensed open source; no account or hosted service.
api_notes: Single function: username lookup; output to txt/csv/xlsx. No hosted API; would need to be wrapped by running the CLI/Python package in a sandbox.
main_blocker: no hosted API; must wrap CLI in own runtime

what_it_does: B2B contact and company enrichment, search and email verification via waterfall providers.
auth_notes: API key in x-api-key header (per third-party connector docs; official docs at docs.waterfall.io not opened).
access_notes: Could not confirm signup/trial/pricing model from official sources (site not fetchable, search budget exhausted).
api_notes: ~23 async launch-then-retrieve endpoints: contact/company/phone enrichment, contact/company search, prospector, job change, company reveal, email verify, account usage, API key mgmt.
human_needed: confirm how to obtain API key (signup vs sales)

what_it_does: GTM data platform for prospect search, enrichment and outbound workflows.
auth_notes: Public API key in clay-api-key header (created in API and CLI settings or via `clay api-keys create`). CLI uses browser/device login.
access_notes: Clay says the developer platform is available on all plans incl. free and trial; Tables API is Enterprise-only; usage consumes Clay credits.
api_notes: Public API v0 (api.clay.com/public/v0): search, routines (functions/workflows, batch runs), tables (Enterprise), audiences, credits, webhooks; OpenAPI spec published.
